Arc2.description: Exact analytical circular arc (authoritative — never tessellated in IR).

start_deg.description: Start angle in degrees CCW from +X (east).

sweep_deg.description: Signed sweep angle in degrees (+90 = CCW, -90 = CW).

symbol_origin.description: Exact symbol origin anchor in sheet mm (matches KiCad `(at X Y orient)` for verbatim library symbols).

oneOf.description: Open-ended geometry for externally registered domains (plumbing, hvac, pcb, ...). `shape` names the payload schema owned by the domain; `data` is arbitrary JSON in project model coordinates (mm).

repair_suggestions.description: Actionable repair suggestions when a check is violated.

ExplicitFieldStyleIr.description: Exact lossless explicit schematic sheet representation (used when `routing { mode: explicit }` preserves human/KiCad-authored geometry alongside EDL's semantic `circuit {}` netlist).

raw_lib_symbols.description: Verbatim `(symbol "<lib_id>" ...)` S-expressions required by this sheet.

instances.description: Optional per-hierarchy-path RefDes overrides for reused sub-sheets (`"/sheet1": "C201"`).

MepCircuitIr.description: Building electrical breaker circuit summary & computed IEC/NEC metrics.

MepWireRunIr.description: Physical conduit/wire run or switch-control line overlaid on the architectural floor plan.

NetTerminalIr.description: Local schematic terminal graphics (GND triangle, upward power bar, named net-label stub, or global flag).

body_point.description: Pin attachment point on symbol body edge (sheet mm).

no_connect.description: True when explicitly flagged as No-Connect (`no_connect: [...]` or `role: nc`).

pin_code.description: Optional exact library pin code (e.g. `"A1"`, `"7"`, `"EP"`); defaults to `number` if absent.

tip_point.description: Pin wire-connection tip (sheet mm, snapped to 2.54mm grid).

RelationIr.description: Functional connectivity relation (strictly separate from drawn wire routes).

hierarchy.description: Optional hierarchical module path segments parsed from `/Module/Sub/Net` notation.

RepairSuggestion.description: Structured, actionable repair suggestion attached to a violated verification proof.

auto_fixable.description: True if a tool/agent can safely apply this fix mechanically without domain guesswork.

SchematicRouteIr.description: Presentation-layer orthogonal wire route (or symbol/label-stub termination) for a functional net.

SchematicSubZoneIr.description: Sub-zone divider inside a framed schematic zone (e.g., "DECOUPLING CAPACITORS" or "ADDRESS SWITCHING").

SymPrim.description: Vector primitive for electronic/industrial schematic symbols in world mm (Y-down).

oneOf.description: Open or closed polyline in world mm.
Small symbol-internal glyph label (e.g. `+` / `-` on polarized cap or op-amp).

WallSolidCell.description: Exact non-overlapping wall poché cell (after corner joins, T-junctions, and opening cutouts).
